title: When to redesign measurement panels in biology and medicine: code, models and calculator
description: Code, fitted model coefficients, the decision rules, the value-of-information ordering chart and an offline web calculator accompanying the article "When to redesign measurement panels in biology and medicine". Version 1.2.0 adds the cross-domain analyses (drug response, kinase activity, proteins, gene expression, genetic dependencies and single-cell expression), the molecular and clinical decision rules, the locked tests and the figure scripts. No participant data are included; all data are available from their providers.
